info.title: EDGAR Terminal Research and x402 Data APIs
info.description: Free public research APIs and six paid machine products: prepared company financials, snapshot pages, multi-company financial bundles, fundamental screens with peer percentiles, and debt/liquidity screens. Paid GETs cost 0.01 USDC on Solana. New batch and screen products support JSON/CSV. Public research remains free; paid products provide selected, normalized delivery rather than exclusive ownership of SEC records. Optional exact-response recovery is available for 24 hours after staging. Consult /api/x402 for availability.

get.summary: Read concise prepared company financial research
get.description: Cache-only projection of six business-specific financial metrics with current/prior values, exact periods, units, calculated-versus-reported labels, source contexts and SEC filing links. Never fetches SEC data or writes a new financial history. Annual is the default. An older end selects latest-filed values for that reporting period, not a historical information set. Filing-cutoff asOf requests return 503 because historical vintages are not prepared by this endpoint. Unknown, duplicate and empty query fields are rejected. Missing data never means zero.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Exact available reporting-period end, no later than today; omit for latest.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Filing cutoff. Valid dates return 503 without substituting current-vintage figures.

200.description: Prepared financial highlights. Source freshness and calculation time are separate.

400.description: Invalid, duplicate, empty or unknown selector.

503.description: Prepared research, period or vintage unavailable. Retry-After: 60; no-store.

get.summary: Read a prepared N-PORT fund summary
get.description: Cache-only read with up to ten positions, source dates, coverage and SEC links. Never fetches SEC documents or starts a refresh. Omit accession for the prepared latest report; an explicit accession pins one filing and excludes later amendments. Missing prepared data does not establish that no filing exists. Unknown, duplicate or empty query parameters are rejected.

200.description: Prepared summary; stale may be true. N-PORT weights retain the full net-assets denominator and may be negative or unavailable.

400.description: Invalid fund ticker, accession or query parameters; private, no-store.

get.summary: Read a prepared Form 13F manager summary
get.description: Cache-only read of a complete prepared quarter with up to ten positions, coverage, dates and SEC filing sources. Never fetches SEC documents or starts a refresh. Omit period for the prepared latest quarter. Weights use all reported 13F holdings value, not assets under management or net assets. Unknown, duplicate or empty query parameters are rejected.

parameters.name: cik
parameters.description: Nonzero manager CIK, normalized to ten digits.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: A non-future calendar quarter end with year greater than zero.

200.description: Complete prepared quarter; stale may be true, including when newer evidence is incomplete. Options and confidential omissions remain explicit.

400.description: Invalid manager CIK, reporting quarter or query parameters; private, no-store.

get.summary: Read bounded CFTC history for one contract and participant group
get.description: Calculates net contracts, net as a percentage of open interest, exact 7/28-day changes and no-look-ahead within-contract percentiles.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Must belong to the selected family.

get.summary: Compare prepared CFTC positioning across 25 public futures markets
get.description: Parameter-free, shared public comparison built only from existing prepared histories. Never starts SEC or CFTC acquisition and contains no portfolio holdings or allocations. TFF markets use Leveraged Funds; Disaggregated markets use Managed Money. Net/OI changes require exact seven-day observations and are percentage-point differences. Historical ranges use available observations within the trailing 52-week window, including current; range.position is linear min/max placement, NOT a percentile. Preserve per-market report dates, actual observation counts and date spans, nulls, stale and incomplete flags. A ready row can contain stale, incomplete or unavailable individual values; inspect its summary. HTTP 200 may contain partial or entirely unavailable prepared coverage. All query parameters are rejected.

200.description: Fixed public catalog with validated summaries or explicit unavailable rows; preparation of all markets is not guaranteed

get.summary: Discover paid resources, pricing and current activation status
get.description: Free catalog. No payment authorization or API key is required. Reports payment configuration and native-USDC receiving-account readiness. recipient-setup-required means the receiving account needs setup; recipient-check-unavailable means its readiness could not be checked temporarily. These states do not collect payment. An active catalog does not guarantee that every dataset is prepared.

Financial reporting periods, units and source evidence use the same prepared calculator model as the research application. As-filed historical vintages are not guaranteed. Price is 0.01 USDC on Solana mainnet per successfully settled GET. Public research remains free. No source acquisition is initiated by this request. Inspect the 402 offer before authorizing payment.

get.summary: Batch normalized financial histories for one to ten companies
get.description: Cache-only prepared data. One bounded successful response costs 0.01 USDC. Invalid selectors, absent data, no matches, conflicts and oversized responses are not settled. Unknown, duplicate and empty query fields are rejected. format=csv returns RFC 4180 CSV with source, selection and pagination context in columns. Screen snapshot tokens bind both source data and criteria; keep criteria identical on subsequent pages. Financial batches require every selected company to be available and are not historical as-filed archives. Responses are bounded to 4 MiB.

get.summary: Recover the exact response of an opted-in settled purchase without paying again
get.description: Provide the same private recovery token used on the original signed GET. No query parameters or payment headers are accepted. Recovery does not resubmit settlement, recompute data or expose pending content. Access expires 24 hours after staging; pending settlement may require manual reconciliation.

200.description: Exact original successful JSON or CSV bytes and settlement receipt

202.description: Settlement is pending; no paid content is returned

400.description: Missing or invalid token, query parameters or payment headers

PaymentRequired.description: Base64-encoded x402 protocol v2 payment requirements. Inspect amount, asset, network, recipient and resource before signing.

ExtensionResponses.description: Optional base64-encoded extension outcomes reported by the facilitator. Inspect bazaar.status (success, processing or rejected); a paid response alone does not prove external catalog admission.

PaymentResponse.description: Base64-encoded x402 settlement receipt for this paid response. Keep the transaction identifier for support.

period.description: kind, start, end, fiscalYear and fiscalPeriod of the selected reporting period.

unit.description: Unscaled USD, percent (%), USD/shares, shares, ratio, days or count.

observationPeriod.description: Instant or duration context for this metric.

previous.description: Prior comparable value with its own classification, formula, sourceIds and calculations.

change.description: Compatible year-over-year delta; percent-valued deltas are percentage points. Growth needs a positive prior base.

items.description: Exact SEC XBRL input context, source value, accession and SEC archive URL; revision flag does not imply error.

coverage.description: Displayed, available, reported, calculated and comparable metric counts, source count and prepared history periods.

PublicFundSummary.description: At most ten displayed holdings with the original full-portfolio denominator. Missing numbers are null, not zero. Unavailable responses can omit summary fields and do not establish that no SEC filing exists.

valueBasis.description: N-PORT net-assets provenance: reported, assets less liabilities, or unavailable.

stale.description: Ready evidence can be stale. False on unavailable responses is not a freshness claim.

positionCount.description: Full prepared portfolio position count, including positions outside the displayed top ten.

valuedCount.description: N-PORT positions with known USD values.

weightCount.description: N-PORT positions with known net-asset weights.

weightBasis.description: N-PORT net assets or all reported 13F holdings value; never rescaled to displayed positions.

comparable.description: 13F report permits complete portfolio comparisons under its disclosed coverage.

identifier.description: N-PORT ISIN, CUSIP or ticker when available; 13F CUSIP. May be empty for N-PORT.

snapshot.description: SHA-256 token identifying the complete prepared snapshot. Pin it on later page requests.
Snapshot metadata without the full company collection; preserve coverage, dates, stale flags and methodology.
Snapshot metadata without the full company collection; preserve coverage, dates, stale flags and methodology.

asset.description: Case-sensitive native USDC mint on Solana mainnet.

amount.description: Exact per-request price in USDC token base units.

payTo.description: Public Solana settlement recipient when configured. Addresses are case-sensitive; no private key is returned.

discovery.description: Server discovery capability, not proof of external listing. Each resource carries its declaration and service metadata.

asOf.description: An as-filed cutoff is not supplied by this endpoint.

sourceCatalog.description: Prepared source catalog; preserve units, periods and original evidence.

PublicFundUnavailable.description: No validated prepared summary is available, or its cache cannot be read. This does not establish that no filing exists and never starts SEC acquisition. Open the interactive research tool to request preparation.

NotFound.description: No validated observation for the requested selection

Unavailable.description: Prepared data or upstream source is temporarily unavailable

X402BadRequest.description: Invalid, duplicate or unsupported selection. The request is not settled.

X402RateLimited.description: The signed-payment attempt or concurrency limit was reached before payment verification. No payment is settled. Wait for Retry-After before retrying the original request.

X402ResourceFailure.description: A prepared response could not be delivered as a valid billable JSON resource. Settlement was not attempted; this request is not charged.

X402PageOutOfRange.description: PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE: the requested offset is beyond the prepared snapshot. The request is not settled.

X402MethodNotAllowed.description: HEAD is unsupported and returns no body. Only GET and OPTIONS are supported on paid resources; HEAD never verifies or settles a payment.

X402PaymentRequired.description: An unpaid valid resource returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED with the offer. Verification failures or definitive settlement rejection can also return 402 and may include PAYMENT-RESPONSE without a fresh offer. Do not assume every 402 permits a new authorization. Inspect the error and preserve transaction information; do not automatically sign a replacement after a paid attempt. Payment configuration is checked before an offer; source readiness is checked before settlement.

X402Unavailable.description: Payment configuration, recipient readiness, settlement or prepared source data is unavailable. Recipient-setup and recipient-check errors occur before payment collection. A pending or indeterminate settlement may have transferred funds. Keep receipt and transaction information, reconcile the original payment and do not automatically create a replacement authorization. Invalid or unavailable source responses are not settled.

X402Conflict.description: Conflict: SNAPSHOT_CHANGED means the requested snapshot changed and this request is not settled; restart pagination. payment_already_used means an authorization was already claimed or used, with a status and possibly a transaction identifier. Pending or unknown settlement must be reconciled before another authorization; do not automatically sign a replacement payment.

X402Payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
X402Payment.description: x402 v2 signed payment authorization, not a static API key. Obtain requirements from a 402 response, validate the offer and sign with a funded Solana wallet.

X402RecoveryToken.name: X-X402-Recovery-Token
X402RecoveryToken.description: Private random client capability for an opted-in purchase. No wallet signature or new payment is required to recover an already settled response.
